description: Search tokenized real properties on the Fabrica protocol (Ethereum Mainnet). Returns a list of properties matching the given filters. Each result is a real parcel of land in the US, held in a trust whose beneficial interest is an ERC-1155 token.

hasListings.description: Only show properties with active sale listings

hasLoans.description: Only show properties with active loans

minScore.description: Minimum confidence score (integer). Defaults to 72032, the marketplace threshold, except when ownedBy is set (then every property in that wallet is listed). Any minimum also requires a verified deed. Max: 75342.

name: search_properties
title: Search properties
